goals: Keep canonical full leaves entirely provider-owned while making BGE-derived leaf geometry visibly bushy through provider-neutral, additive foliage.
Use BGE canonical bindings and exact exposed SurfacePatch geometry as the sole authority for material identity, resolved topology, and decorative attachment footprint.
Sample active final canonical leaf appearance after public Fabric model wrapping, without resource-path, registry-name, or provider-specific conventions.
scope: Canary 4 captures each canonical-root leaf BlockStateModel after ModelModifier.WRAP_LAST_PHASE, retains the clean BGE base model, and appends authored two-sided slanted cards only over merged binding-owned surface patches.

The cards preserve the sampled canonical quad's block-atlas/sprite, tint, render layer, UV, emissive, light, and shading behavior through public FRAPI quad accessors before changing authored positions and normals; source atlas backing data is never read; non-cull samples are preferred and ordinary canonical leaf quads are the fallback.

The generic path covers BGE horizontal Slabs, resolved Stairs and Walls, Vertical Slabs, Steps, Layers, Corners, and Quarter Columns; a centralized small-support rule scales or omits a motif without geometry-name branches.

exclusions: BGE remains unchanged and owns canonical material identity plus resolved SurfacePatch topology; BGE × CTM remains optional adjacent context, not a dependency or geometry authority.
No bushy-leaf resource-pack, mod, texture, model JSON, shader, provider class, or asset is copied, redistributed, or modified. The protected Minecraft testing profiles are not inspected or changed.

Inventory, hand, creative-menu, JEI, collision, outline, placement, drops, recipes, waterlogging, leaf distance/persistence/decay, rain drip, redstone, pathfinding, and BGE family membership remain untouched.
No registry-name inference, per-geometry ID list, Stair/Wall special branch, guessed cube halo, broad same-leaf decorative culling, or gameplay-state mutation is permitted.

dependencies.reason: C78 is the oldest demonstrated BGE capability that supplies authoritative resolved patches for every requested topology; C84 is the controlled C4 compile baseline.
Canary 4 targets Minecraft Java 26.2 public block-model and renderer-quad interfaces.
Provides the public model-loading and renderer APIs used by the client-only C4 wrapper.

dependencies.requirement: optional; sampled at client resource reload
dependencies.reason: Owner runtime evidence confirms Foundation v2 visibly supplies the active full-block bushy leaves in the real stack. C4 samples whichever final canonical baked leaf appearance is active and does not package or depend on Foundation, Matcha, or another provider's resource path.
Minecraft 26.2 and the controlled build use Java 25.

exceptions.reason: Canary 4 uses Minecraft 26.2's public final model and Fabric renderer-quad seams while consuming BGE's capability-owned surface contract rather than a BGE release-name check.
regression_evidence: Java 25 / Gradle 9.5.1 / Fabric Loom 1.17.19 --rerun-tasks check and staged JAR build against BGE C84 SHA-256 9c3a7af8eb86ffabcf5ddc3c7ba96134fb4322c6b92c3530dc8788edac015759 produced bge-bushy-leaves-0.2.2-canary4.jar, 31,958 bytes, SHA-256 06147c8eb94c43f348da0a2876f1bb71edb9d356d08a28825b77c52bd17a3ac2 from implementation checkpoint 20d85767d311eff9b08ee9801998daa8a0f7358b.

Twenty-one focused synthetic/unit tests passed, including a wrapped-QuadView regression whose atlas accessor throws for missing backing data and which verifies explicit block-atlas emission plus the existing public FRAPI transfer of layer, item type, emissive/AO/shading/animation metadata, tint/tag, UVs, colors, lightmaps, normals, nominal face, and no cull face; semantic, appearance, reload, deterministic patch-local, and BGE geometry fixtures also passed.

Controlled verification passed BGE API and Fabric renderer/model-loader hash gates, JAR metadata and required-class checks, and provider-asset exclusion checks; it is not Minecraft visual/runtime evidence.

current.summary: Avoids Sodium's unsafe wrapped-quad atlas read while retaining deterministic patch-local foliage geometry and canonical block-atlas appearance.
